moonspore-tree.x: Moonspore trees are a common type of [[trees|tree]] found in [[cave-of-memories|cave of memories]] in [[savannah|Savannah]] that can be grown from moonspore seeds. An moonspore tree can be shaken to obtain moonspore seeds, or can be cut down to obtain moonspore seeds, [[slime-goop|slime goop]], [[hardwood|hardwood]], and [[black-trumpet|black trumpet]], or [[tap|tap]]ped to produce [[ball-of-goop|ball of goop]].
Moonspore seeds can be planted in any season, and takes around 5 days to grow.
